description: Defines a class for design-time data related to page previews in a WPF application, within a PDF processing library project.

classes.name: PagePreviewDesignTimeData
classes.description: A class providing fixed design-time data for canvas dimensions in a page preview component.

methods.name: CanvasWidth
methods.description: Property returning a fixed width (210 units) for the preview canvas.

methods.name: CanvasHeight
methods.description: Property returning a fixed height (297 units) for the preview canvas.
